source: M1 full scientific execution and selective replay recorded by scripts/verify_wf_rc_m1.ts

model.detector_integration: 5x5 nearest FFT-grid samples per detector pixel
model.spatial_psf: nearest radial field PSF rotated to local radial direction
model.stamp_interpolation: linear rotation and shift of the sampled detector PSF
model.distortion: radial odd polynomial fit to geometric centroids
model.edge_energy: fraction of the normalized finite stamp inside the detector
